verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.cockroachlabs.com that indexes the documentation. Markdown versions of the docs pages are also served, and they direct agents back to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.cockroachlabs.com/llms.txt # CockroachDB
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.cockroachlabs.com/llms.txt
